title: Корпус: склад і версії
fields_and_relations: Критерії, group/reason, ordered exact target revisions, access snapshot.
required_interaction: Freeze/new version; відкликаний елемент лишає дозволене посилання, не старі bytes.

implementation.view_model: Ordered exact source versions, criteria/reason/group, immutable history and explicit next version
limitations: UI applies a shared reason/group to the selected batch; per-item reordering and grouping are pending.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store, fixture version 4; migration preserves existing edits and revoked grants
permissions: research.write in an explicit archive grant
domain.read rechecked for every source, note, assertion, citation and download
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, compare expected corpus/assertion revision, mutate clone, validate exact FK/versions and immutable corpus membership hashes, commit once.
